nodes.label: Gate 10 Fault Matrix (Target)
nodes.description: Generated target file for Gate 10 fault injection. No live-Docker run performed. Instructs running python scripts/gate10/fault_injection.py --scenario all in a Docker-capable environment after supplying GATE10_* configuration. The harness overwrites this file with current SHA, per-scenario result, correlation IDs, and JSON evidence path.
nodes.rationale: Placeholder for the fault injection results. Documents that Scenarios A-E (Laravel dies post-commit, consumer dies after XADD before ACK, Redis outage + recovery, poison CDC record → DLQ, process restart) have not been executed on the live stack.
